statement: ∀ (a b : ℝ) (f g h : KdVPlan.Path), a ≤ b → KdVPlan.EssBound 0 a b f → KdVPlan.EssBound 0 a b g → KdVPlan.EssBound 0 a b h → ∀ k, IntervalIntegrable (fun t => (fun (t : ℝ) (f g h : KdVPlan.Coeff) => KdVPlan.S (-t) (KdVPlan.P (KdVPlan.mul (KdVPlan.P (KdVPlan.mul (KdVPlan.S t f) (KdVPlan.S t g))) (KdVPlan.S t (KdVPlan.invD h))))) t (f t) (g t) (h t) k) volume a b
proof:
intro a b f g h hab hf hg hh k
apply (intervalIntegrable_iff_integrableOn_Icc_of_le hab).mpr
have hm := @yui_aux_0036 T gamma R h_E003 h_T013 (volume.restrict (Icc a b)) f g h hf.1 hg.1 hh.1 k
apply Integrable.of_bound hm (KdVPlan.EssH 0 a b f*KdVPlan.EssH 0 a b g*(KdVPlan.hn 0 (KdVPlan.invD (fun _ => 1))*KdVPlan.EssH 0 a b h))
filter_upwards [hf.2.1, hg.2.1, hh.2.1, @yui_aux_0032 T gamma R h_E003 h_T013 0 a b f hf, @yui_aux_0032 T gamma R h_E003 h_T013 0 a b g hg, @yui_aux_0032 T gamma R h_E003 h_T013 0 a b h hh] with t hft hgt hht hfb hgb hhb
apply (@yui_aux_0029 T gamma R h_E003 h_T013 t (f t) (g t) (h t) hft hgt hht k).2.trans
have hn₁ : 0 ≤ KdVPlan.hn 0 (f t) := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
have hn₂ : 0 ≤ KdVPlan.hn 0 (g t) := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
have hn₃ : 0 ≤ KdVPlan.hn 0 (h t) := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
have hn₄ : 0 ≤ KdVPlan.hn 0 (KdVPlan.invD (fun _ => 1)) := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
have hn₅ : 0 ≤ KdVPlan.EssH 0 a b f := ENNReal.toReal_nonneg
have hn₆ : 0 ≤ KdVPlan.EssH 0 a b g := ENNReal.toReal_nonneg
have hn₇ : 0 ≤ KdVPlan.EssH 0 a b h := ENNReal.toReal_nonneg
gcongr
